exceptions.reason: Base UI turns this file into `prehydrationScript.min.ts` with a minifier. No component imports the template. Vase UI has no minifier.

exceptions.title: does not link Slider.Label before hydration
exceptions.reason: A server render with no `hydrate()` runs in Node with no DOM. The case asserts that the server HTML has no `aria-labelledby` on the root and on the input of the thumb. Vase UI has both attributes on the server. The root assumes its label until it is mounted. The thumb defers its render. Its input then has the id of the label, with the label before or after the control. The case "VUE-29: links the label to the root and to the input of each thumb, with the label $name" asserts the server HTML.

exceptions.title: explicitly blurs the focused thumb when disabled
exceptions.reason: Base UI runs the case only in jsdom, and it asserts a call of `blur()` with a spy. Firefox moves the focus off a disabled input itself, so the root has nothing to blur there. The case "does not keep the focus on a thumb that becomes disabled" asserts the result in each engine: the thumb does not keep the focus.

exceptions.title: should pass "name" and "value" as part of the event.target for onValueChange
exceptions.reason: VUE-147 keeps the original event. The case with the same title checks its identity, the value argument and the input name.
